name: Dust
desc:
Dust is a Celtor NPC. They are a [Diver](faction:the_divers).

They can be found praying in front of a tombstone in the cemetery that was built to the left on the outskirts of the Castle Light, mourning their fallen fellow Divers.
additional_info:
-   Dust's racial variant appears to be Badger.
-   They share the same hair combo as [Karliah](entity:karliah).
